# Web font sources

- OPPO Sans 4.0: original glyph outlines and weights, web embedding subsets; copyright OPPO Guangdong Mobile Telecommunications Co., Ltd. Official terms: https://www.coloros.com/article/A00000074/
- ZhiYue Headline: Source Han Serif SC variable font web subset, copyright Adobe, SIL OFL 1.1. The subset has a distinct primary font name. See source-han-OFL.txt.
- ZhiYue Reading Serif: LXGW Neo ZhiSong web subset, SIL OFL 1.1. The subset has a distinct primary font name. See lxgw-OFL.md.

These are font assets embedded for the study site; no font download feature is provided. Source fonts are kept outside the deployment directory.
